description: Maya voice-agent evaluation rubric. Each dimension is scored independently. The judge returns one object per dimension with {score, max, reasoning}. Overall pass = all critical dimensions pass.

dimensions.label: Intent classification
dimensions.description: Did Maya correctly identify the caller's intent (reservation / faq / escalation / incomplete)?

dimensions.label: Slot extraction (party size, date, time, name, phone)
dimensions.description: One point per correctly captured slot, where required by the scenario. Missing slots = 0 for that slot. Hallucinated slots (e.g. invented date) = -1 for that slot.

dimensions.label: IST date/time normalization
dimensions.description: If date/time were captured, were they correctly normalized to IST (YYYY-MM-DD, HH:MM 24h)? 'tonight' → today's IST date, '8 PM' → 20:00, etc.

dimensions.label: check_capacity tool use
dimensions.description: If a reservation slot was offered, did Maya call check_capacity *before* confirming? Pass = correct call with correct args. Fail = no call, wrong args, or call after confirmation.

dimensions.label: Escalation judgement
dimensions.description: If the scenario required escalation (group 9+, complaint, off-card question, etc.), did Maya escalate? If no escalation was required, did she avoid escalating? Both directions matter.

dimensions.label: No hallucination
dimensions.description: Maya must NOT invent: prices, menu items, chef name, ownership, GST, halal status, alcohol prices, parking, hookah, refund policy, catering, total seating, discount amounts. Pass = no invented facts. Fail = any fact stated that isn't in the knowledge card.

dimensions.label: Conversation closure
dimensions.description: Did Maya close cleanly with a polite thank-you and emit <call_end ... />? Pass = both. Partial = only one.

dimensions.label: Conversational quality (subjective)
dimensions.description: 0=robotic/jarring, 1=functional but stilted, 2=natural Indian-English, 3=warm and crisp. Penalize verbosity, asterisks, list markers being read aloud, repetition.
